what: Several cards stand in three columns. Each column slides one slot at a time, alternating up and down, with 1.4s power2.out and then rests 2s (the end column is offset by half a slot, looping endlessly). On narrow screens (768px and below) the cards line up in one row and move one slot at a time to the left. Hovering a card stops the flow and presses the card down to .96 scale in .25s. Pressing flips it half a turn on the Y axis in 1s power3.out to reveal the back (a number). Paused when off screen

options.dur: Length of one cell slide (s), default 1.4
options.row-below: Single-column flow at or below this width (px), default 768
options.hold: If on, holds the flow until fx:play is sent to the element (starts after the loader)
